mode_reason: RC-129: operator delegated the isolate-vs-share call 2026-07-29; decided SHARED. The probe-live law (RC-125) and rendered-DOM verification need Claude's edits in the tree the running server serves, and git forbids one branch checked out in two worktrees, so sibling isolation breaks the edit->restart->probe loop. Role explicitness and the dirty-protected-source handoff block are unchanged. Flip back by setting mode to 'isolated'.
description: Shared-root operation (see mode_reason). The isolated design remains available: Cursor uses the primary checkout; Claude uses <primary>-Claude via git worktree (shared .git object store). No absolute operator-home paths — suffix + ED_AGENT_ROLE only.

roles.cursor: Primary worktree; must NOT end with claude_root_suffix. ED_AGENT_ROLE=cursor required.
roles.claude: Dedicated worktree; directory name MUST end with claude_root_suffix. ED_AGENT_ROLE=claude required.

fail_fast: ED_AGENT_ROLE unset or invalid → exit 1. No inference from directory name.
db: ONE DB: data/ed_console.db for every role and every worktree. RC-401 removed the per-agent fork (Claude → data/ed_console_claude.db) — ambient ED_AGENT_ROLE was deciding which database the money path addressed, and it had scattered real rows into three sibling files. ED_CONSOLE_DB / ED_DB_PATH still override, and a non-canonical target still requires ED_CONSOLE_ALLOW_NONCANONICAL_DB=1.
handoff: Commit or stash in the active worktree before the other agent reads shared HEAD. tools/check_worktree_handoff.py enforces dirty-source + boundary.
